name: campus-food-street
description: 校园美食街：微信小程序与统一后端，不包含 H5 / App

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:generate && npm --prefix apps/miniapp ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/miniapp run build:mp-weixin
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/miniapp run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/miniapp run typecheck && node --check scripts/smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/prisma-db-push.mjs
